# Victoria Zeder

> Victoria Zeder is a formally trained visual artist based in Miami, Florida. Born in the Dominican Republic in 1991, she works in painting and mixed media, exploring biomorphic biomimicry and Jungian expression through 24k gold leaf, acrylic ink, thread, and encaustic. Her current body of work, Living Systems (2026), explores the dynamics between proximity and distance in visual form.

## Identity

- **Name:** Victoria Zeder
- **Discipline:** Visual Artist — Painting and Mixed Media
- **Born:** 1991, Dominican Republic
- **Based:** Miami, Florida, United States
- **Website:** https://victoriazeder.com
- **Email:** hello@victoriazeder.com
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/victoriazeder.art/

## Practice

Victoria Zeder's practice traces a geographic and psychological journey: from the lush maximalism of her Dominican origins, through the interior stillness of her Michigan years, to the atmospheric restraint of her Miami work. She engineers pareidolia through flow states — the moment when form rises from pure process and reveals something that was always there.

Her practice spans five bodies of work across the Dominican Republic, Michigan, and Miami. She moves fluidly between large-format painting, dimensional sphere sculpture, and textile-based thread work. Each series is a chapter in an evolving study of biomorphic form.

## Current Series — Living Systems (2026)

Living Systems explores the dynamics between proximity and distance, and how relationships form, expand, and converge within spatial and emotional frameworks. Each composition resists fixed form, instead reflecting systems in flux: responsive, interdependent, and continuously evolving.

## Materials and Techniques

- 24k gold leaf (applied by hand, torn, placed, burnished)
- Acrylic ink (deposited via custom-built precision-aperture drip funnels)
- Wool and cotton thread (dimensional, with tassels)
- Encaustic wax (hand-formed spheres over rigid armatures)
- Heavyweight canvas

Her signature tool is a drip funnel she engineered herself — a precision-aperture instrument that deposits acrylic ink in continuous dots, spirals, and lines at speed, without direct surface contact. The canvas lies horizontal on the studio floor while the artist moves over and around it.

## Selected Works

- **Living Systems** (2026) — Gold leaf, acrylic, thread on heavyweight canvas. 36 × 48 in.
- **Living Systems 3D** (2026) — Encaustic sphere, acrylic, circles on stretched canvas. 36 × 48 in.
- **Thread on Black** (2026) — Wool and cotton thread, dimensional forms, tassels on canvas. 16 × 20 in.
- **Pareidolia in Blue** (2025) — Acrylic, 24k gold leaf, thread, encaustic on canvas. 48 × 36 in.
- **Pareidolia: Blue Mandala** (2025) — Acrylic on canvas. 30 × 40 in.
- **Pareidolia Chromatic** (2024) — Acrylic ink, 24k gold leaf, mixed media on canvas. 48 × 36 in.
